Name: Animated Clothes
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Clothes

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Replaces some of the default clothes with animated versions.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/MPIGCIF.gif[/img]﻿[/center][/size]
[b]1.1.0[/b] Added 10 more shirts.

[size=3][u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations
[/url][/size]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]

[b][size=5][u]Config[/u][/size][/b]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i][size=3]config.json[/size][/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.[/size]
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i][size=3]content.json[/size][/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.

[/size][size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]I may add more animated clothes down the line.
